subject: IP allowlist + service account gating sync for Orion Health onboarding
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Tanya Rao <tanya@orionhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: IP allowlist + service account gating sync for Orion Health onboarding

Hi Tanya —

Thanks again for the kickoff yesterday. To keep the onboarding timeline tight, I want to confirm the short list of technical gating items we agreed would be completed before tenant activation in staging:

- IP allowlist for Redwood's staging egress IPs (per-environment CSV)
- Scoped service accounts with least-privilege role matrix and expiration policy
- SCIM provisioning toggle plan for groups + SCIM service account credentials
- Org-level policy for admin user federation (SAML/SP-initiated)

I've attached an IP allowlist template and a draft service-account role matrix to make the handoff easier. Can your infra team confirm the preferred window for the staging allowlist change and whether you have a change freeze on Sundays?

Proposed next steps (short):
1) Your infra provides allowlist target IPs in CSV by EOD Monday (we provided template).
2) Monica will prepare the scoped SA roles and share the recommended TTLs for keys.
3) Ben will loop in procurement only if we need a PO adjustment for Dedicated capacity changes.
4) Quick verification call Wed morning (30m) to test SCIM provisioning to staging.

If that looks good I'll send a concise mutual action plan doc and a DocuSign for the MAP sign-off.

Thanks —
Soojin
Customer Success Lead
Redwood Inference
---
Attachments: ip-allowlist-template.csv (CSV stub), sa-role-matrix.xlsx (Excel stub)
From: Tanya Rao <tanya@orionhealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Cc: DevOps Team <infra@orionhealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@orionhealth.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: IP allowlist + service account gating sync for Orion Health onboarding

Soojin —

Appreciate the clear checklist. Quick answers from infra:

- Change window: we prefer weekday windows 02:00-04:00 PT; weekend changes require a 48h CAB. Staging is more flexible if we keep it to <15m network change.
- We'll fill the attached CSV with the staging egress IPs and return it by Monday 15:00 PT.
- Service accounts: we require key rotation every 90 days for non-human accounts and enforce MFA for any admin console access.

A few clarifying Qs before Monica's matrix: 
1) Can Redwood accept conditional allowlist entries (CIDR /28) per environment, or do you need single IPs?
2) For SA TTLs, do you support automatic short-lived tokens via our OIDC flow, or will we provision long-lived keys?

If it's easier I'm happy to confirm answers on Wed call — what time were you proposing?

Thanks —
Tanya Rao
Director, Platform Engineering
Orion Health
---
Attachments: none
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Tanya Rao <tanya@orionhealth.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 13 Sep 2026 07:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: IP allowlist + service account gating sync for Orion Health onboarding

Hi Tanya / Soojin —

Short answers to Tanya's questions and a proposed config sheet included. I've attached an updated SA role matrix (sa-role-matrix.xlsx) with our recommended defaults and the minimal set of permissions for staging verification:

- Redwood supports CIDR entries (we accept /32 or /28 ranges). The template now shows examples for env-specific CIDRs.
- For onboarding verification we can provision short-lived OIDC-backed tokens for test runners (recommended). For persistent system integration we can issue scoped long-lived keys but we strongly suggest a 90-day rotation policy and automated rotation hooks.

Proposed Wed verification call: Wed 2026-09-15 09:30 PT (30m). Agenda:
- Quick confirm of CSV values (infra)
- Provision SA for staging + test run (Monica)
- SCIM group sync dry-run (Soojin / Tanya)
- Confirm MAP sign-off items and DocuSign flow (Ben)

Action items I will take before the call:
- Add token/rotation rows to sa-role-matrix.xlsx
- Prepare a one-page verification checklist (m-a-p-orion-20260912.pdf)

If that time doesn't work please propose alternatives.

Best —
Monica Patel
Implementation Lead, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
---
Attachments: sa-role-matrix.xlsx (Excel stub), m-a-p-orion-20260912.pdf (MAP stub)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Tanya Rao <tanya@orionhealth.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 13 Sep 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: IP allowlist + service account gating sync for Orion Health onboarding

Tanya —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. We're aligned to the proposed plan. A couple of implementation notes from platform/ops perspective:

- For production cutover we'll require a /32 per active egress node; for staging /28 is fine. Please include both staging and prod column headers in the CSV so we can stage-then-cutover without rekeying.
- We'll enable an allowlist TTL of 30 days for staging entries with an automated reminder to your infra team 3 days prior to expiry (optional).
- SCIM: when you flip the provisioning toggle, Redwood will write a dry-run log to your audit webhook endpoint for 1 hour before committing. Please provide the webhook URL if you want the dry-run routed off-host.

Confirming Wed 2026-09-15 09:30 PT works for me. Monica — please bring the verification checklist. Soojin — I'll stand by to approve any SLA/commitment exceptions if procurement needs to move the Dedicated commit window.

Jonas Weber
Director, Platform Reliability
Redwood Inference
